detail.notes: All stages passed. Bridge handshake reported desktop.connected=true and context state=ready at revision 0. Preview of the 13-block batch reported changedBlocks=13; apply returned changedBlocks=13 with user approval and advanced revision 0->1. Camera pose was at position [26,84,34] looking toward the origin area, so the tiny platform appeared small in frame; capture metadata legend listed 13x minecraft:stone with stale=false. Fix preview/apply changed 1 block (revision 1->2) and the second screenshot legend updated to 12x stone + 1x glass with stale=false. Block reads confirmed minecraft:glass at (0,64,0) and minecraft:stone at (1,64,1). Every viewport capture returned partial=true with 4 of 9 requested chunks loaded and 5 missing (( -1,1),(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0),(1,1)); images were still produced with stale=false and authoritative revisions matching render revisions. Undo of the fix (undo_e328b02816fd40e7b15782adaa28d52c) restored stone at (0,64,0) at revision 3, and undo of the build (undo_432171de29a147eaa96226c665c2397e) cleared 13 blocks at revision 4. Final world_info and region inspect of the same 100-block bounds show blockCount=0, sectionCount=0, nonAirBlocks=0, palette entirely minecraft:air, confirming full restoration.
